Area Codes Search Notes

Fixed phone numbers in the United States, state New York (area code 914) are comprised of a single country code (+1), a 3 digit area code, a 3 digit local office code (or region code), and a 4 digit line code. Making a call with the wrong country, area, or region code can be costly. Browse our sites area and region codes by state and city to ensure you have the correct information for your calls. Each states page contains a list of the cities within that state and the numbers of that area. Also available are local times. So you don’t have to worry about calling too late or early again.
